reviews.title: Be ready to lose access to your account
reviews.text:
I switched to a new phone and can no longer access my LINE account because the app insists that I transfer it from my old phone, which I no longer have.

I tried creating a new account, but LINE says an account already exists. So I can’t log into my existing account because it requires an impossible transfer, and I can’t create a new account because it keeps directing me back to the account I can’t access.

It’s an incredibly frustrating, circular process with no clear way to resolve it. This is terrible app design. Users should have a straightforward way to recover their accounts without needing access to their old devices.

reviews.title: 広告がウザい！
reviews.text:
以前書いたレビューが何故か消えたのでまた書きます。トーク画面の上に常に広告がありますが、✖️ボタンの代わりに、小さい○に斜め線が入ったボタンがあり、そこを押して広告を消しても、同じ広告が何度も現れます。しかも小さい為、指が広告に被ってしまい、そのページに飛ばされそうになってしまう事も（最近だと、ミニ動画形式になってたりする）。ニュース画面にあった記事を別サイトで読もうとしたら、とにかくしつこく、色んな広告がページごとに現れます。企業商品の売り上げが広告によって成り立っているのは分かりますが、あまりにもしつこ過ぎる！　逆効果になってしまうのが、分からないのか！？
追記…下のニュース欄に赤いNマークが付いてれば、新しいニュースが届いているサインのはずだが、新しいニュースが無いのにNマークが付いてる場合や、トーク画面に行ってトーク内容を読み、戻るボタンを押した瞬間、ほぼ100%の確率で、新しいニュースが無くてもまたNマークが付いたりするのは意味不明だ！
あと、ニュース画面やトーク画面からホーム画面に行こうとするとたまに、画面の下の方に隠れて見えなくなってるニュースやトーク（画面をスクロールすると見えるやつ）が、何故か反応して開いてしまうという、謎現象もあります！

reviews.title: 多機能いらん、無駄に重い
reviews.text:
メッセージのやり取りと通話だけできればいいのに、なんか無駄にいろんな機能追加してって、どんどん重くなるのどうなん。余計な機能排除して軽くしたいんだけど。VOOMとかみんな喜んでるの？
今はもうどこもやり取りにライン使うのが当然になって、メールや電話でいいよねってならないから使わざるを得ないけど、正直消したい。無駄に重い、本当に無駄に重い。無駄に、重い。
なんと言うかこう、無茶な要望だとは思うんだけど、ユーザーで必要な機能といらない機能取捨選択できる様にできない？マジで重くてしんどいんだけど。なんでメッセージアプリがギガで容量取ってんだよ。
後、不具合も多い。アプリ開くまで通知こないとかたまにあるし。いいとこないじゃんマジで。余計な機能消して軽くして維持費抑えて広告も消そうぜ？ダメ？本当にあらゆるもんが邪魔。



追記

複数人のグループで誰からのラインなんやろ思って既読つけずに見たくて長押しでつけたら、下の方の最新メッセージ表示されなくなって誰からのラインかわからなくなってるやんけ。通知で見ればええ思うかもしれんが、ライン君はなぜか通知が来ない事がずっと前からあって、開くまでラインが来てた事自体わからん事があんねん。余計な機能なんてほんっっっとうにいらんから、前のにもどしてや。バグ治せとかもうできないんだと思ってるから、ほんと余計なことだけせんといてや，ほんまに。なんでユーザーの声には耳を傾けんで、勝手な判断で余計なことばかりすんねん。メッセージアプリ界隈でほぼほぼ独占状態だからって殿様になってんとちゃうで。誰も彼もが使っとるから本当に仕方がなくこれ使ってるってだけで、このアプリを評価してるから使ってるわけじゃないってことを、本当に理解してな運営さん。

reviews.text:
以前書いたレビューが何故か消えたのでまた書きます。トーク画面の上に常に広告がありますが、✖️ボタンの代わりに、小さい○に斜め線が入ったボタンがあり、そこを押して広告を消しても、同じ広告が何度も現れます。しかも小さい為、指が広告に被ってしまい、そのページに飛ばされそうになってしまう事も（最近だと、ミニ動画形式になってたりする）。ニュース画面にあった記事を別サイトで読もうとしたら、とにかくしつこく、色んな広告がページごとに現れます。企業商品の売り上げが広告によって成り立っているのは分かりますが、あまりにもしつこ過ぎる！　逆効果になってしまうのが、分からないのか！？
追記…下のニュース欄に赤いNマークが付いてれば、新しいニュースが届いているサインのはずだが、新しいニュースが無いのにNマークが付いてる場合や、トーク画面に行ってトーク内容を読み、戻るボタンを押した瞬間、ほぼ100%の確率で、新しいニュースが無くてもまたNマークが付いたりするのは意味不明だ！
あと、ニュース画面やトーク画面からホーム画面に行こうとするとたまに、画面の下の方に隠れて見えなくなってるニュースやトーク（画面をスクロールすると見えるやつ）が、何故か反応して開いてしまうという、謎現象もあります！

reviews.title: Terrible Account Recovery and Customer Support
reviews.text:
I got a new phone and tried to log in to my LINE account and transfer my existing account, but the experience has been absolutely terrible.

I have my phone number, email address, and Apple ID, yet LINE refuses to let me recover my account using any of them. The only option it gives me is to send a verification code to my old phone, which is dead. That’s exactly why I need to transfer my account to my new phone in the first place!

What is the point of having multiple ways to identify and verify your account if none of them can actually help you recover it? The verification system is completely unreasonable, and the customer support is extremely disappointing.

I have been setting up all my other apps on my new phone without any problems. LINE is the only app giving me this nightmare. I have also seen many other longtime users reporting the same issue and losing years of contacts and connections, with seemingly no meaningful solution from LINE.

An app should not make it this difficult for legitimate users to regain access to their own accounts. People invest years in building their contact lists and relationships on this platform, and losing all of that because of a rigid account recovery system is unacceptable.

I’m posting this review to raise awareness and hopefully get LINE to take this issue seriously. If you are considering relying on LINE for your important contacts, think twice. And if LINE is listening, please fix your account recovery system and provide real custom

reviews.title: Account lost forever after new phone. Unacceptable for a messaging app.
reviews.text:
I’ve used Line for years to stay in touch with important contacts overseas. 

After getting a new phone and trading in my old one, I can no longer log in. The app refuses to let me recover or transfer my account using my U.S. phone number, so years of conversations and contacts are just gone. I can’t communicate with people I relied on this app for.

This “security feature” is ridiculous. People upgrade or replace phones all the time—often yearly. Expecting users to lose their entire account and all their data just because they no longer have the old device is absurd and completely out of step with how modern apps work. Other messaging platforms allow proper account recovery or transfer via phone number, email, or backup codes. Line’s approach effectively locks people out permanently in a common, everyday situation.

Developers and support need to fix this immediately. Make it possible to transfer or recover a Line account through a verified U.S. phone number without requiring the old phone. 

Until then, I can’t recommend this app to anyone who travels, lives abroad, or simply plans to upgrade their device.

reviews.title: Camera Permission Logic Bug in QR Scan. Blocks Live Camera Unless Photos Permissions Granted
reviews.text:
There is a critical functional bug and UX flaw in the QR code permission flow that directly impacts the core add-friend experience.
When attempting a live QR scan after granting Camera Permission, the app still refuses to open the live camera preview unless Photos Permission is also granted.
This is not about scanning a saved image from the gallery—it is a live camera feed. Mandatory gating of an completely unrelated permission creates unnecessary friction and causes immediate user drop-off in what should be LINE’s most seamless core action: adding friends.
Please decouple the permission logic between Live Camera Scanning and Photo Library Access to fix this broken flow in the next update.

reviews.title: I can’t login through my phone now
reviews.text:
I’m honestly pretty disappointed with LINE’s customer support.

I deleted the LINE app from my phone because my phone storage was full. I did not delete my LINE account. I can still access my existing LINE account on my PC, so I know the account is still there.

However, after reinstalling LINE on my phone, I can’t log back into my account. The phone only gives me options such as logging in with Google, Apple, or a phone number. I tried logging in with the Gmail account associated with my LINE account, but it still didn’t work. My U.S. phone number also isn’t accepted.

I’ve tried contacting LINE support several times to explain the situation, but I haven’t been able to get a helpful response. Now, when I try to submit another inquiry, the inquiry form itself gives me an error.

It’s really frustrating because I can still use my account on my PC, but I can’t access the same account from my phone. I understand that LINE has security policies, but I wish there were a clearer way for users in this situation to recover their accounts.

I’m honestly pretty sad and disappointed with the support experience.

reviews.title: Trash App Transfer
reviews.text:
LINE has to be one of the most frustrating messaging apps I’ve ever used.

Trying to transfer your account to a new phone is an absolute nightmare. Unlike virtually every other modern messaging service—Messenger, Google Chat, Slack, and countless others—LINE makes something as basic as accessing your own account unnecessarily complicated.

And somehow, it gets even worse: when I finally gave up and tried to create a completely new account, LINE wouldn’t even let me do that. I attempted to sign up with Apple ID, only to have the app lock me out for seemingly no reason.

How can a messaging app make both transferring an existing account AND creating a new account such a painful experience?

This isn’t a minor inconvenience. These are basic functions that users should be able to complete quickly and reliably. Instead, LINE seems determined to put roadblock after roadblock between users and their own accounts.

The entire experience feels outdated, unnecessarily restrictive, and incredibly user-unfriendly. I’ve never seen an app make account access this frustrating.

At this point, I’m completely fed up with LINE. If the developers don’t seriously rethink how account transfers, authentication, and account creation work, I genuinely don’t understand how they expect people to keep using it.

Absolutely terrible user experience. I’m done with this app.

No option on the app to use email and password (which I have) - only Apple ID or Google. Even though both are associated with my email, LINE says they can’t identify any existing account - even though when I use google, the google app screen says “I’m signing back in” to LINE. Still can’t get in. Tried creating a new account but if I try to add my email it says it will unlink from my old account (acknowledging it exists in the first place) and only be used with my new account.  So basically LINE knows my account is there and none of its login methods is smart enough or working to link the 2 accounts together. The “inquiry” form is terrible and doesn’t allow free typing so you have to choose the right prompts and attach screenshots and just hope you did it right. Currently waiting for a reply from support.

reviews.title: Questionable Suspension
reviews.text: I was in Taiwan when I downloaded line as that is the primary form of communication. I was in a single group chat with family members when suddenly I could no longer send messages. When inquiring about why my account was suspended, line said that they could not provide any information regarding the reason for or duration of suspension, which makes it impossible to recover my account. It has been over a year now since my account has been suspended. It is neither logical nor conductive to user experience to provide no reasoning behind the suspension. Furthermore, it is nearly impossible to get in contact with support staff to resolve this issue. I do not understand why anyone would use this app as their primary source of communication. There are several better structured, more secure, and streamlined apps that could otherwise be used. This has been an exceptionally frustrating experience.

reviews.title: Ok while it worked
reviews.text: I’d like to continue using LINE, but the app on my old phone stopped working (it’s an old version or something, it just gives 400 errors whenever I try to do anything. I can’t log in or transfer my account to any other device now, because that requires my old app to work. I also can’t sign up for a new account either, because my old account is linked to my phone number (which no longer works for authentication in the US) and my Apple ID. When I try to create a new account, I get a “please sign in with your existing account” message. Which, I can’t do, because that requires my the app on my old phone to work. So it seems that I’m totally locked out of LINE now and can never use it again. They must have had to work really hard to make an authentication system this convoluted and user-unfriendly.

reviews.title: Not a user friendly app
reviews.text:
Recently, I traded in my old iPhone for a new one. After transferring my data to the new phone, I erased all information from the old device and submitted it to Apple. The entire transition worked perfectly—except for LINE.
I couldn’t log in using my phone number. The app required a registered email address, which I didn’t have because I created the account a long time ago. I was stuck dealing with this issue for hours with no solution. Eventually, I realized that I had to create a new account.
This shouldn’t have been a problem since nothing had changed. Why do they make such a simple and basic task so frustrating?
I only use this app because I communicate with people in Asia. I’m not sure why LINE is so popular there—I don’t find the app very useful or user-friendly.

reviews.title: Terrible account recovery and customer service
reviews.text: I recently purchased a new phone which included a trade-in of my old device. After transferring all of my data to my new phone, I wiped my old phone and submitted it to the Apple Store, not thinking too much about logging back in to my Line account since I hadn’t changed phone numbers or any other sensitive information. I had switched phones back in 2021 and had no issues transferring everything over. Upon returning home, I discovered that I needed the old device to verify my account, and without it I would have no way of accessing my contacts or chat history on Line— I was completely locked out and would have to make a brand new account. I reached out to customer support, and they did nothing to help me recover my account but repeatedly send me to help articles that did not fit my situation. I’ve lost contact information for friends and family abroad that I may never be able to get back, all because of an inflexible security policy and completely useless customer service platform. I would not recommend this platform if you can avoid it.
